reply.Text:
Based on the ABDM developer portal documentation, here are the **7 different Milestones in ABDM Sandbox**:

## **M-Series Milestones (HIP/HIU Integration)**

**M1** — ABHA Creation & User Authentication
- Create ABHA using Aadhaar OTP, demographic auth, or face auth
- User login and profile management
- ABHA discovery and child ABHA creation
- Mobile number updates on ABHA profile
- 74 documentation atoms covering these flows

**M2** — Care Context Linking & Record Exchange
- Link care contexts to ABHA addresses
- User-initiated and HIP-initiated linking
- Asynchronous callbacks and link confirmation
- SMS notifications for care context updates
- 57 documentation atoms

**M3** — Consent Management & Data Request (HIU)
- Initiate and manage consent requests
- Fetch consent artefacts
- Request health information with consent
- Consent status tracking and notifications
- 20 documentation atoms

**M4** — Facility & Professional Registration
- Onboard facilities to the Health Facility Registry (HFR)
- Register healthcare professionals (HPID)
- Link facilities to bridges
- Facility search and management
- 11 documentation atoms

## **P-Series Milestones (PHR App Integration)**

**P1** — PHR App Enrollment & Login
- Create ABHA address in PHR applications
- Mobile OTP-based login and verification
- User profile and PHR card management
- Refresh token generation
- 29 documentation atoms

**P2** — PHR App Discovery & Profile Sharing
- Discover records held at facilities
- Link care contexts from search results
- Share profile by scanning facility QR codes
- Provider search and selection
- 18 documentation atoms

**P3** — PHR App Consent & Subscriptions
- Manage consent requests and auto-approval policies
- Subscribe to patient record updates
- Revoke and fetch consent artefacts
- Health locker setup and management
- 36 documentation atoms

Each milestone builds sequentially on the previous one, starting with basic ABHA creation (M1), progressing through record linking and consent (M2-M3), facility setup (M4), and then PHR app-specific flows (P1-P3).
